releases.label: v1.1
releases.note: v1 + desalted re-docking (PocketVina 0.2.0, 2026-10-29 to 2026-11-01, 793 entries); v1 data unchanged; ChEMBL annotations refreshed 2026-11-02 (309 entries matched by exact standard InChIKey)

chembl_refresh.rule: entries without a catalogue ChEMBL ID: ChEMBL 37 molecule with the same standard InChIKey (docked structure for entries docked as the drug, largest fragment otherwise); annotations, indications and ChEMBL flags as for catalogue IDs; column chembl_id_source

headline.default_text: 2,559 drugs + 31 non-drug entries (24 salt counterions, 2 solvents, 5 product components)

subset: test fixture of the PocketVina package: 3 proteins and a few drugs each, rows and pose files filtered (tests/data/atlas/make_fixture.py)
pb_null: PoseBusters not run yet (re-dock rows): pb, n_failed and pb_mask are null

flags.8: docked as a salt counterion, solvent or product component (not the drug)
flags.16: all-mode poses available for every pocket of the pair

tooltips.salt_counterion: Docked structure is the salt counterion, not the drug molecule. This is a data-preparation artefact of the original screen.
tooltips.solvent: Docked structure is the solvent, not the drug molecule. This is a data-preparation artefact of the original screen.
tooltips.fragment: Docked structure is one component of a multi-component product (or the metal ion of a complex), not the drug molecule. This is a data-preparation artefact of the original screen.

proteins.definition: Human proteins with docking results: AlphaFold DB v6 models, one per UniProt accession.

compounds_library.definition: Entries (catalogue numbers) of the approved-drug library (Selleck) used as input.
compounds_library.source: fda_drugs_cat_smiles.txt (file name of the original screen)

catalogue_numbers_docked.definition: Catalogue entries docked: library entries whose ligand was prepared and docked in at least one batch (v1), plus the desalted re-docking entries (<CAT>-desalted).

catalogue_numbers_with_results.definition: Catalogue entries with docking results (v1 and desalted).

desalted_entries.definition: Entries of the desalted re-docking (PocketVina 0.2: the salt's largest fragment docked) whose docked structure is the drug; key <CAT>-desalted.

desalted_excluded.definition: Re-docked catalogue numbers left out: the largest fragment is again a counterion, solvent or product component, or the ligand could not be prepared.

pvl_new_in_v1_1.definition: PVL IDs with results that exist only through the desalted re-docking (structure not docked in v1).

drugs.definition: PVL IDs (docked structures) with results whose docked structure is the drug molecule.

non_drug_entries.definition: PVL IDs with results whose docked structure is a salt counterion, a solvent or a product component, not the drug.

not_docked_as_drug.definition: Catalogue numbers whose drug molecule was not docked in this release (a counterion, solvent or product component was docked instead, and the drug has no other docked entry, desalted entries included).

pairs.definition: Protein-PVL pairs: one canonical run each (the lowest v1 catalogue number docked as the drug, else the lowest desalted entry, else the lowest catalogue number); the highest-affinity pose of v1 runs was checked by PoseBusters (not yet run on the re-docking).

pairs_added.definition: Pairs added by the desalted re-docking (protein-PVL pairs without a v1 run).

pairs_shown_from_redock.definition: Pairs whose canonical run is a desalted re-docking run.

redock_runs.definition: Protein-entry runs of the desalted re-docking (pairs rows with source = redock_v0.2, canonical or replicate).

redock_pocket_runs.definition: Pocket runs of the desalted re-docking with scores.

replicate_runs.definition: Pairs docked again under another catalogue number of the same docked structure; kept, not shown.

pocket_runs.definition: Docking runs, one per pair and pocket (up to 5 pockets per protein), over all catalogue numbers.

pocket_runs_without_modes.definition: Pocket runs whose all-mode poses are not in this release (scores and highest-affinity pose are).

proteins_with_missing_modes.definition: Proteins with at least one pocket run without all-mode poses.

poses.definition: Docked poses (Vina modes) with scores over all pocket runs.

redock_poses.definition: Docked poses (Vina modes) of the desalted re-docking.

pockets_per_protein.definition: P2Rank pockets docked per protein (the top-ranked ones; fewer if P2Rank finds fewer).

modes_per_run.definition: Vina modes requested per pocket run (Vina may return fewer).

box_size_A.definition: Edge of the cubic docking box around each pocket centre, in Å.

pb_checks.definition: PoseBusters checks run on the highest-affinity pose of each v1 pair (the re-docking: not run yet, pb = null).

batches_with_docking.definition: Batch folders with docking output (the others had no protein with pockets).

notes.statistics: Atlas-wide percentiles, top hits, drug counts and summary statistics count drug entries only (docked_as = drug). Entries whose docked structure is a salt counterion, a solvent or a product component stay in the tables with their label.
notes.not_docked_as_drug: 22 catalogue numbers: the drug molecule was not docked in this release; list: not_docked_as_drug.csv
notes.desalted: Salt entries keep their v1 run (counterion, solvent or component docked). The desalted re-docking adds one entry per salt whose largest fragment is the drug (<CAT>-desalted, same names and ChEMBL ID as the salt entry, or a ChEMBL ID by exact InChIKey of the docked structure when the salt entry has none); its runs are shown on protein pages unless a v1 entry docked the same structure as the drug. Left out: excluded.tsv.
notes.pose_files: Rows carry pf: 0 = poses/<UNIPROT>.poses (record index cidx), 1 = poses_redock/<UNIPROT>.poses (record index cidx - 3037).
notes.missing_modes: All-mode poses are not available for some pockets in this release (missing_modes.json).
notes.source_names: Source file and folder names of the original screen are kept as they are (fda_drugs.txt, fda_drugs_cat_smiles.txt, PG_Akalin_whole_fda_proteomics/whole_fda_proteomics); the input is an approved-drug library (Selleck).

paper.title: PocketVina Enables Scalable and Highly Accurate Physically Valid Docking through Multi-Pocket Conditioning
paper.authors: Sarigun A, Uyar B, Franke V, Akalin A

bulk_files.content: one PVATLAS1 pose file per protein (v1 runs)
one PVATLAS1 pose file per protein (desalted re-docking, N = 818, record index cidx - 3037)
